verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own Convex Auth library for building sign-up/sign-in flows with social identity providers and passwords (plus one-time codes), aimed at client-side React and React Native apps. It also documents integrations with Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit and Auth0. Missing for 10: no evidence for the 'in minutes' setup speed or a step-by-step quickstart, Convex Auth is scoped to React/React Native clients, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
